slug: 2025-10-13 Comesa payment system connects Malawi, Zambia

facts.fact: TNM Mpamba, a mobile-money operator, is named as an early Malawian adopter of the platform, and mobile-money penetration in Malawi is said to be below 45 percent in 2025.
The platform integrates banks and non-bank players including mobile-money operators, with FDH Bank, Finca Malawi and TNM Mpamba as early Malawian adopters.
